reason: Reached only through devDependency @anthropic-ai/mcpb@2.1.2 (the latest release), which pins its own nested zod@3.x copy under node_modules/@anthropic-ai/mcpb/node_modules/zod; npm audit offers no fix because no mcpb release depends on a patched zod. The flaw is memory exhaustion while validating oversized constrained collections; the nested copy only validates the local manifest.json when scripts/build-mcpb.sh packs the .mcpb bundle, and is not shipped in the published package or the bundle. The server itself resolves zod@4.6.7, which is patched. Re-check for an @anthropic-ai/mcpb release on zod 4 before this expires; extend only with a fresh date and reason.
